final: WITH event_level AS (SELECT b.link_to_event, e.type, AVG(CASE WHEN b.amount > 0 THEN b.spent * 1.0 / b.amount ELSE NULL END) as event_avg FROM budget b JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id GROUP BY b.link_to_event, e.type), type_level AS (SELECT type, AVG(event_avg) as type_avg FROM event_level GROUP BY type), overall AS (SELECT AVG(type_avg) as overall_average FROM type_level) SELECT t.type, t.type_avg, t.type_avg / o.overall_average as ratio FROM type_level t CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE t.type_avg IS NOT NULL AND o.overall_average IS NOT NULL
